_what: The words src/rule_bindings/rules_and_runs.rs says, each the words Trillion said in the same case.
unanswered_request: The trigger rules asked for {kind}, which is not answered here.
unanswered_read: Nothing here answers a read of {from}; give the value as an answer instead.
too_many_writes: This run asks to write {count} records; one run writes at most {most}.
bad_write: A step's write must name a record id and its type: {id}.
not_own_write: A step writes only the account's own records, not {kind} rows the rules and runs keep.
other_type: The record {id} is a {held}, not a {type}; nothing was written.
changed_since_read: The record {id} is not what the step read; nothing was written.
write_refused: The records write refused this run's writes ({why}); nothing was written.
unreadable_recipe: The workflow {workflow_id} is kept here but cannot be read as a definition: {why}.
job_ended: The job {job} the run waited on ended {status}: {said}
too_many_steps: it has more than {most} step rows
